definitions.gloss: price reduction; lowering prices; price cut
definitions.explanation: The act of reducing the price of goods, services, or rates.

examples.japanese: ガソリンの{値下|ねさ}げが{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: A reduction in gasoline prices was announced.

examples.japanese: {競争|きょうそう}のため{値下|ねさ}げを{余儀|よぎ}なくされた。
examples.english: We were forced to reduce prices due to competition.

examples.japanese: セール{期間中|きかんちゅう}は{全品|ぜんぴん}10%{値下|ねさ}げします。
examples.english: During the sale period, all items are reduced by 10%.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{値|ね} (price, value) + {下|さ}げ (lowering, from {下|さ}げる)

VERB FORM:
{値下|ねさ}げする - to lower prices (transitive suru-verb)
{値下|ねさ}げされる - prices are lowered (passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{値下|ねさ}げを{発表|はっぴょう}する - to announce a price reduction
・{値下|ねさ}げ{交渉|こうしょう} - price negotiation
・{大幅|おおはば}な{値下|ねさ}げ - significant price cut
・{値下|ねさ}げ{競争|きょうそう} - price war

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{割引|わりびき} - discount
・{安売|やすう}り - bargain sale
・セール - sale

ANTONYM:
・{値上|ねあ}げ - price increase
